source_note: Receiver thresholds and GNSS signal levels for the AoE estimator (docs/plans/jammer-aoe.md A2, §7.1). Data, not code (NFR-06). threshold_js_db = the jammer-to-signal ratio at which the class is denied.

provenance.nominal: RC (GPS L1 C/A nominal received power)

provenance.rx_antenna_gain_toward_jammer_dbi: DES/RC (patch gain toward a horizon jammer)

gnss_civil.source: Forssell & Olsen 2003 Table 3: civil loss of 3-D fix at J/S 36-58 dB; the model uses the lower bound 36

gnss_mil.source: DAGR P(Y) tracking, design worked-example value. The 'DAGR spec' source is unverifiable (V17); the verifier recomputed 42-45 dB. 41 is conservative (a larger military AoE).

uhf_comms.source: Comms link J/S threshold for the simulator's FHSS UHF link (comms-sim C2/C3); not estimated or drawn in the MVP
